description:
Free Klondike is a unique solitaire game that combines the best elements of FreeCell and classic Klondike Solitaire. Created by Matt Stephen and developed by a dedicated team, this game offers a fresh twist on traditional solitaire gameplay.
KEY FEATURES:
• 1 or 3 Card Draw modes
• Saved Statistics tracking your win rate and streaks
• 3 Chooseable Card Backs
• 3 Chooseable Backgrounds
• Easy to Learn, Easy to Play interface
• Helpful Hints for when you're stuck
• Undo All Moves back to original layout
• Cross-platform compatibility with Java
• Celebratory Win Animation with fireworks and inspiring music
• Save Game on Exit to continue later
• Automatic Update Checks
• 3 Difficulty Levels (Easy, Medium, and Hard)
• Top 10 Times Scoreboard
UNIQUE GAMEPLAY:
This innovative game blends features from both FreeCell and traditional Solitaire:
FreeCell Similarities:
- All cards in columns are always visible
- Four individual cells at the top for strategic card placement
Solitaire Similarities:
- Deck and discard pile for drawing cards
- Only Kings can be placed at the top of empty columns
- Cards can be removed from Ace piles and returned to the playing field
- Multiple cards can be moved in one move (when properly stacked)
Exclusive Features:
- Four individual cells start with cards already placed
- Limited deck passes: twice on draw one, three times on draw three
- Compact layout with only four columns (vs 7 in Solitaire, 8 in FreeCell)
Free Klondike is published by Velbazhd Software LLC and is licensed under GPL v3.0, meaning you can modify the code in accordance with the license. The game features beautiful card designs from jfitz.com and original graphics by our talented art team.
Download Free Klondike today and experience a new dimension of solitaire gaming!
